scope: Necessary-condition and identity diagnostics only, not the candidates' proposed real-data performance experiments

cases.input: Linear observation J=diag(2,1), y=(4,4), prior mean=(0,0), prior precision=I, theta0=(2,4).
cases.interpretation: The candidate does not define r. Test the conventional residual at theta0, and separately the residual at the prior. Do not silently repair the original.
cases.comparator: Exact regularized least-squares MAP (J^T J+I)^-1 (J^T y+prior_mean)
cases.expected: If residual is evaluated at theta0, the written prior-plus-update expression differs from exact MAP; if evaluated at the prior, it is the standard MAP operator.
cases.threshold: Maximum coordinate error above 1e-10 is a counterexample for the stated interpretation.
cases.limit: Not evidence that every interpretation or implementation of M06 fails.

cases.input: 64 seeded 7x7 positive-definite information matrices, A^T A+I; seed731; pose block6 and focal block1. All coordinates already normalized.
cases.comparator: Pose block of the inverse full information matrix
cases.expected: Inverse Schur-complement pose information equals the corresponding full inverse block.
cases.threshold: Maximum entry difference <=1e-9 in all64 cases.
cases.limit: Tests the established operator identity, not aerial performance, rank-deficient cases, or the proposal's ambiguous physical unit scaling.

cases.input: 48 fixed-grid world points from each of two already downloaded OrthoLoC samples; finite positive-depth nominal geometry only; controlled uniform world-z shifts -3,-1,-0.1,0.1,1,3 metres.
cases.comparator: Analytic camera translation compensation t'=t-R*(0,0,h), equivalent to camera centre shifting by h in world-z
cases.expected: Uniform-height mode has identical image projections after compensation, exact unit camera-centre sensitivity, and no advantage over analytic propagation.
cases.threshold: Maximum projection difference <=1e-6 pixels; finite pose-translation derivative error <=1e-10.
cases.limit: One included mode only; no matcher, PnP solver, RANSAC switch, nonlinear alternative modes, dataset-wide ranking, or real DSM error truth. Cannot reject the entire nonlinear hypothesis from this case.

acceptance: No diagnostic outcome alone counts as experimentally supported research value or satisfies the original performance gates.
